scope: One completed BC experiment and selected source-access decisions. This is a curated research review, not a complete acquisition history or an independently learned research policy.

outcome.target: log1p quantified-positive stream-sediment Cu (mg/kg), AAS method

coverage.meaning: Source rows and retained evaluation samples; not new deposits or global coverage.

cost.meaning: Payload size of one archived assay workbook. Transfer retries, metadata, labor and total compute cost were not metered; unknown is not zero.

outcome.decisionUtility: Recorded promotion decision only. Financial value and research-policy utility have not been evaluated.
outcome.nextAction: Retain the spatial baseline. A further geological hypothesis needs a new independent source and frozen evaluation; do not retune on this audit.

sourceDecisions.name: BC RGS2020 assay release
sourceDecisions.outcome: The frozen comparison did not establish reliable improvement. Audit is consumed.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A distinct independent cohort and a preregistered protocol are ready; this release cannot reopen the audit.

sourceDecisions.name: USGS Gunnison historical operating account
sourceDecisions.outcome: Supports the historical cathode scenario; current capability and uncommitted supply remain unknown.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A newer permitted operating observation is identified; unchanged downloads add no evidence.

sourceDecisions.name: Gunnison Copper company reports
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source links and access status only
sourceDecisions.outcome: Publisher reuse permission is unresolved for this product. Company figures are excluded.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: Applicable reuse permission is established, or an independently permitted source supplies the required facts.

sourceDecisions.name: Freeport-McMoRan company reports
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source links and access status only
sourceDecisions.outcome: Publisher reuse permission is unresolved for this product. Company figures are excluded.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: Applicable reuse permission is established, or an independently permitted source supplies the required facts.

sourceDecisions.name: EPA Gunnison permit records
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source link and observed access status only; permit facts remain unpublished
sourceDecisions.outcome: The queued URL returned HTTP 404 on one local access check. No original PDF was acquired; document and reuse review remain incomplete. Cached search text is not admitted evidence.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: An accessible official copy or a verified official replacement is identified. Do not periodically retry the unchanged URL; do not infer permit revocation from an access failure.

sourceDecisions.name: Cochilco Chile production, covered sales and export destinations
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Attributed statistics from tables 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 2.9 and the table 4.9 volume rows only
sourceDecisions.outcome: 250 annual production, 10 covered cathode-sales and 50 export product-weight observations for 2016–2025. Customs destination is not final demand; product weight is not contained copper. Facility routing and available supply remain unknown.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A new release or a decision-relevant table with reviewed original-provider permissions is identified; do not redownload unchanged evidence.

nextInvestigations.question: What current cathode output can a specified facility sustain?
nextInvestigations.reason: The supply screen has historical context but no current production or uncommitted allocation.
requires: Identify the exact project, facility and process; do not transfer output between related assets.
Review permission, dates, units and evidence of sustained output, quality, inventory and commitments.
Separate a design, permit, announced plan and actual operating measurement.

nextInvestigations.question: Can a geological hypothesis pass a new independent evaluation?
nextInvestigations.reason: The BC geology candidate failed its uncertainty gate; the earlier soil and BC audits are permanently consumed.
requires: Choose an independent, previously unexposed cohort and review lineage/overlap.
Freeze source eligibility, target, baseline, candidate, geological constraints and uncertainty gate before audit exposure.
Keep failed gates in the record; do not rename, resplit or change seeds to reuse either audit.

nextInvestigations.question: Which permitted source can connect dated output across a copper processing chain?
nextInvestigations.reason: National totals and common ownership do not establish facility-level flow allocations.
requires: Review the selected table and original-provider permissions.
Bind persistent facility IDs, material basis, measurement period and observed output.
Require explicit routing/allocation evidence; leave unknown links and recoveries null.

scheduling.rule: Revisit only on the stated evidence or permission trigger. No recurring download job is installed.

limitations: This review was written after the BC result; it is not preregistration of that experiment or of the next proposals.
Source eligibility and reuse decisions do not certify current operating truth.
Publication of this review changes no audit, membership, evaluator, seed, prediction or model.
Priority is a curated order proposed during implementation; expected utility, costs and improvements in research selection remain unmeasured.
The EPA access observation is a local record of one response, not proof of permanent removal, permit validity or source truth. No permit facts or current output were imported.
